environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed as part of a Step Functions Express workflow for order processing. The Lambda is invoked via API Gateway (REST API with Lambda proxy integration) allowing external callers to trigger the workflow with arbitrary encrypted_order payloads. The Lambda execution role has AmazonStepFunctionsFullAccess and CloudWatchLogsFullAccess. No permission boundaries applied. API Gateway has no request validation or WAF. The Step Functions state machine is configured with a Pass state that returns the Lambda output directly to the caller, including the specific error messages distinguishing padding errors from other decryption failures.

config.api_gateway: REST API, Lambda proxy, no WAF, no request validation
config.step_functions: Express workflow, synchronous invocation, output passed to caller
config.error_handling: Lambda errors propagated to API response
